edition: Standing Regulations (current year — verify at acu.org.uk)

chapters.note: Do not invent clause numbers. ACU publishes annual Standing Regulations PDF. Key sections typically include: General Regulations, Road Racing Specific, Technical Regulations by class, Licence Grades and Upgrade Criteria. Download current PDF from acu.org.uk.

regionalVariations.scotland: SACU applies own standing regulations under FIM/ACU framework — see sacu.co.uk
regionalVariations.northernIreland: MCUI Ulster Centre regulations apply for NI events — see mcui-uc.org.uk
regionalVariations.publicRoadEvents: Separate supplementary regulations for IOM TT, Manx GP, NW200, Oliver's Mount. Not covered by standard ACU short-circuit regulations.

note: Prefer ACU National Sporting Code + Road Racing Standing Regulations and event supplementary regulations. BSB / MCRCB technical regulations are separate from club Standing Regulations. SACU applies for Scotland; MCUI for Northern Ireland. Do not invent clause numbers. Link out when in-app KB is incomplete.
